name: 088 — A word means one thing I
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for the whole of feature 088, tasks 1 to 5, under one command: :list() enumerates everywhere and hafen.ui():list() builds nothing, the selector language is :match/:matchAll, a size is :cellSize and a hit test is :hit while item:cell() and grid():at(p) keep their words, :overlay() means keyed decorations bound to a thing on both the HUD and a gob, and rule:closeButton, pag:categories and ev:widget free the three words 088.5 frees. Every retired spelling is asked to raise and to name its replacement.
